blocks.text: Real Russian sentences that use what the lesson teaches. Type the missing word, or pick it, until it turns green.

These are real sentences: from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR), with their English translations, and from the public-domain Russian books in this library, with author and title. Each blank is the word the sentence really has; the word in brackets is its dictionary form.

exercises.q: От ___ (облысение) нет лекарства.
exercises.why: «от» + genitive. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Tom took a bottle of pills out of his pocket.
exercises.ru: Том вынул из ___ пузырёк с таблетками.
exercises.why: «из» + genitive. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Resume reading where you left off.
exercises.ru: Возобновите чтение с ___, где вы остановились.
exercises.why: «с» + genitive. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: The train had left the railway station.
exercises.why: «от» + genitive. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Чёрный дым вырывался из ___ (окна) третьего этажа.
exercises.prompt: Black smoke spewed out of the third-story windows.
exercises.why: «из» + genitive. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Я хочу начать с ___ (небольшой опрос).
exercises.prompt: I want to start with doing a small survey.
exercises.why: «с» + genitive. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Мой друг умер от ___ (рана).
exercises.prompt: My friend died from a wound.
exercises.why: «от» + genitive. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Don't take out anything from the bag.
exercises.why: «из» + genitive. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: They were oppressed from all sides.
exercises.why: «со» + genitive. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: A button has come off my raincoat.
exercises.why: «от» + genitive. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Том из ___ (учительская) семьи.
exercises.prompt: Tom comes from a family of teachers.
exercises.why: «из» + genitive. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Убирайся с ___ (глаза) моих долой.
exercises.why: «с» + genitive. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Она страдала от ___ (булимия).
exercises.why: «от» + genitive. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Mayuko wore a flower crown.
exercises.why: «из» + genitive. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: I know everything about Tom. We've been together since the infants.
exercises.ru: Я знаю о Томе всё. Мы вместе с ___.
exercises.why: «с» + genitive. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: I suffered from kidney failure.
exercises.why: «от» + genitive. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Том был убит отравленным дротиком, выпущенным из ___ (духовое ружьё).
exercises.prompt: Tom was killed by a poison dart fired from a blowgun.
exercises.why: «из» + genitive. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Она смахнула со ___ (щека) слезу.
exercises.prompt: She wiped a tear from her cheek.
exercises.why: «со» + genitive. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Меня так и распирало от ___ (желание) врезать Тому по физиономии.
exercises.prompt: I was bursting with the desire to punch Tom in the face.
exercises.why: «от» + genitive. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: I kicked them out of my house.
exercises.why: «из» + genitive. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
